newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus Woolworth Zako stop trade.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus Woolworth Zako stop trade.

text.p: Trading in F.W.Woolworth (Cyprus) and Zako on the Cyprus exchange was suspended at the companies' request on Monday after Woolworth made a bid to buy out the smaller company, the exchange announced.

F.W. Woolworth, a Cypriot-owned company and a subsidiary of N.K. Shakolas (Holdings) Ltd., requested a suspension in trading shares of both companies after making a bid to purchase the remaining 45 percent of Zako, a retail cosmetics and accessories outlet.
Woolworth bought 55 percent of Zako in early February. Details of the bid to buy remaining shares were not announced.
The boards of Woolworth and Zako are due to meet on Tuesday morning to consider the buy-out bid.
Woolworth said it sought a suspension of trading for two days for the protection of investors. The board of the Cyprus Stock Exchange (CSE) said it accepted the request.
